strings.210-ФЗ статья 7.1 Не ответило другое вед: 210-FZ Article 7.1 Another agency did not respond
strings.210-ФЗ, статья 11.2, часть 6. Срок рассм: Law No. 210-ФЗ, Article 11.2, part 6. The complaint consideration period; sending the reasoned reply has a separate deadline.
strings.Автоматически удовлетворить требование н: Automatically grant the request regardless of the conditions.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В акте названо только отсутствие ответа: The act cites only the lack of a reply providing interagency information. Article 7.1, part 6 does not permit this as grounds to refuse the applicant. Applicability is limited to the specified information category.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В представленных материалах иных основан: The materials provided state no other grounds for refusal.
strings.Вы работаете в подразделении, обеспечива: You work in the unit supporting consideration of a complaint by the proper recipient. Prepare materials and a draft reasoned decision; do not assume the powers of the body providing the service. The case documents determine the specific recipient. This training service applies Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ; no other special federal procedure is specified.
strings.Выдать чужую запись заявителю как доказа: Give the other person's record to the applicant as proof that the authority has worked on the case.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Гарантировать положительный результат бе: Guarantee a favourable outcome without checking the other conditions
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Для такой ситуации используется часть 6: Part 6 of Article 7.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ applies here: failure to provide the specified inter-agency information is not a ground for refusing the applicant. This does not decide whether every other condition of the particular service has been met.
strings.Досудебная жалоба по главе 2.1 закона №: Pre-trial complaint under Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ
strings.Единственное — непоступление ответа на м: The only ground was that no response to the inter-agency request had arrived.
strings.Единый тридцатидневный порядок независим: A uniform thirty-day procedure regardless of subject matter
strings.Есть ли другие неподтверждённые требован: Are there other service requirements that remain unverified?
strings.Задержка возникла после передачи в орган: The delay arose after transfer to the authority and led to a refusal because of information exchange. This is not a late courier transfer by the MFC.
strings.Заставить заявителя лично получать межве: Force the applicant to obtain inter-agency information personally as a condition for reviewing the complaint
strings.Использовать чужую запись, чтобы закрыть: Use the other person's record to meet the deadline.
strings.Каковы основания отказа в тексте?: What grounds for refusal are stated in the text?
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Какой обмен не был завершён? Свяжите изв: Which exchange was not completed? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения жалобы на отка: Final day for reviewing the complaint against the authority's refusal
strings.Любой неответ ведомства автоматически об: Any failure by an agency to reply automatically obliges the citizen to obtain the information personally.
strings.Мне отказали в услуге: сказали, что друг: I was refused the service: they said another agency had not answered their request. I submitted all my documents. Now they suggest that I visit those agencies myself and collect certificates.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью о межведомственном взаимо: Find the article on inter-agency cooperation under which the absence of a response to a request is not a ground for refusing the applicant.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Не ответило другое ведомство · проверка: Another agency did not reply · checking the basis
Do not attribute the refusal to the centre.
strings.Нельзя автоматически обещать положительн: A favourable outcome cannot be promised automatically, but the stated ground must be checked.
strings.Немедленное удовлетворение любого требов: Immediate satisfaction of every demand without verification
strings.Нет, в условиях прямо указаны межведомст: No, the case expressly specifies inter-agency information under Clause 2 of Part 1 of Article 7.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Орган, предоставляющий услугу; МФЦ тольк: The authority providing the service; the MFC only forwarded the complete package.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Отсутствие межведомственного ответа гара: The absence of an inter-agency response guarantees immediate approval of any service.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Подготовить оценку отказа уполномоченным: Prepare an assessment of the refusal by the authority's authorised recipient
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение жалобы на отказ: Prepare the review of the complaint against the service authority's refusal and a check that inter-agency retrieval has been restored.
strings.Полномочия на итог остаются у надлежащег: Authority over the final outcome remains with the proper body; the unlawful barrier is removed, but other conditions are checked separately.
strings.Помощник: «Если отказ необоснован, студе: Assistant: “If the refusal is unjustified, the student should approve the service personally.”
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
The stated grounds have been identified.
The applicability of the restriction has been checked.
strings.Проверить возобновление надлежащего проц: Check that the proper process resumes without promising an unconfirmed outcome
strings.Проверить идентификаторы и исправить меж: Check the identifiers and correct the inter-agency request; receiving just any response does not verify the applicant's data.
strings.Проверить надлежащую отправку и состояни: Check proper dispatch and the status of the inter-agency request
strings.Проверить необоснованность отказа по при: Check that refusal because of an inter-agency failure was unjustified and that proper review has been restored.

Check whether a refusal caused by a failed interagency exchange was unjustified and whether proper consideration has been restored. The delay arose after transfer to the authority and led to a refusal because of the information exchange. This is not an overdue courier transfer by the MFC.
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Разъяснить заявителю порядок восстановле: Explain how the review will be resumed without imposing an unauthorised requirement to collect certificates
strings.Речь о документах личного представления?: Are these documents that must be submitted personally?
strings.Сбой межведомственного получения нельзя: A failure in inter-agency retrieval cannot be shifted onto the applicant as the sole ground for refusal; the proper authority's act must be assessed.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сверить единственное основание отказа и: Check the sole ground for refusal and the type of information requested
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Сохранить отказ только из-за неответа ве: Maintain the refusal solely because the agency did not reply.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.Требовать от работника МФЦ самостоятельн: Require the MFC employee to approve the service independently in place of the authority.
strings.Участник вымышленной учебной ситуации: Participant in a fictional training situation
strings.Учебное дело: заявитель подал необходимы: Training case: the applicant submitted the required package. The authorised authority refused solely because no response had been received for information subject to inter-agency retrieval. The act gives no other grounds; the MFC transferred the package on time.
strings.Учебное продолжение. Ответ ведомства пол: Training continuation. The agency's response arrived, but it contains another person's record because of an identifier error in the request.
strings.Учебный материал; ссылка ведёт к правово: Training material; the link leads to the legal basis
